area: front2 buckets.rs / check.rs / world_items.rs: answering impl questions mid-check through &self
annoyance: A write-only lane brief allows Read, Grep, Glob, Edit and Write, but this lane's harness offered no Grep or Glob tool, only Bash; read-only greps went through Bash. `Buckets` had a dozen public fields read directly by tests and examples, so moving them under one RefCell touched eight test files for field reads alone. `super::index::Index` already names the impl index's input, so the brief's `RefCell<Index>` is `RefCell<BucketIndex>`.
workaround: Bash grep/sed -n for read-only search only; tests read the moved fields through `Buckets::index()` (a `Ref<BucketIndex>`).
